content: bytes crate: Bytes::from_owner<T>(owner: T) -> Self where T: AsRef<[u8]> + Send + 'static exists and is documented as enabling 'zero-copy construction from mapped memory' - the owner is retained and dropped only once every derived Bytes clone is gone. Current bytes is 1.12.1 (2026-07-08). This is exactly the primitive needed to wrap Arc<Mmap> (or Arc<memmap2::Mmap>) as a Bytes owner with no copy, confirming the existing Span+Bytes API can be preserved unchanged when the backing store moves to mmap segments.
